metadata.title: The Well-Tempered clAIvier
metadata.subtitle: II. Fugue in C minor — The turning path
metadata.style_note: Revised thematic rhythm, linear counterpoint and prepared dissonance; mechanical checks do not establish Bach-level artistic quality.

events.label: Free counterpoint
events.counterpoint_device: Unaccented passing resolution of the leading tone

subject_relative.relationship: Diatonic modal variant of the main subject

sections.label: Continuous exposition
sections.detail: Real answer in Voice 01; recurring invertible countersubject

sections.label: Continuous exposition
sections.detail: Subject in Voice 03; recurring invertible countersubject

sections.label: Sequence toward the relative major
sections.detail: A two-note head of the subject is passed through a directed harmonic sequence; rhythm and intervals are tonally adapted.

sections.label: Relative-key development
sections.detail: Relative-key subject in Voice 01; recurring invertible countersubject; Eb major, a change of tonal mode as well as root

sections.label: Major-mode episode
sections.detail: A two-note head of the subject is passed through a directed harmonic sequence; rhythm and intervals are tonally adapted.

sections.label: Minor-mode return
sections.detail: A directed bass and harmonic progression prepares the next thematic entry.

sections.label: Stretto
sections.detail: The final held tonic of the first subject overlaps the next subject by two beats; this is a mild tail overlap, not dense stretto.

sections.label: Middle-voice final return
sections.detail: Subject in Voice 02; recurring invertible countersubject

sections.label: Final cadence
sections.detail: All 3 parts complete the dominant-to-tonic cadence; the outside voices arrive on tonic.

composition_record.method: Authored formal revision with exact subject variants, tonal head-fragment sequences and constraint-assisted supporting voices.
revision_notes: The genuine two-beat tail overlap is retained and explicitly qualified; no stronger stretto is claimed.
limitations: Structural frame uses triads before the separate diminution/suspension pass.
Symbolic checks do not establish equivalence to Bach or perceptual independence.
reviewed_phrase_repairs: V01, beat60: B5 now rises through C6 on the weak eighth before D6, replacing B-to-D departure with a directed B-C-D line.

second_edition_rhythmic_revision.method: Recurring thematic variants admitted across all their statements; stepwise free-line connections; prepared suspensions. Independent event and structural-grid screens retain the baseline constraints. No random notes or concealed staggered parallels.

performance_revision.description: Deterministic subject/countersubject balance, phrase arches, metrical articulation, connected suspensions, cadence release and keyboard-register stereo placement.
performance_revision.timing: No onset displacement, random timing, tempo changes, or written-duration changes.
performance_revision.soundfont: FluidR3_GM.sf2 General MIDI study samples; not an acoustic performance.
